name: Sunrise Coffee — demo spot

product.label: สถานะสินค้า
product.block: THE PRODUCT — LOCKED DESIGN. THIS RULE OUTRANKS EVERYTHING: a matte-black stainless-steel vacuum flask, 22 cm tall and 7 cm across, a perfectly straight cylinder with NO taper and NO waist. A single brushed-copper band circles the body one third down from the top. The lid is the same matte black, seated perfectly flush so the silhouette stays one unbroken cylinder. Around the base of the lid runs a thin recessed ring. The surface is MATTE — soft diffuse highlights only, never chrome, never glossy, never mirror. It is NEVER a tapered tumbler, NEVER a mug, NEVER transparent; if the body tapers the image is WRONG.
product.short: matte-black stainless vacuum flask with a brushed-copper band

prompt.head: A single photorealistic cinematic still frame, landscape 16:9, from a television commercial.
prompt.tail: Muted filmic colour, gentle contrast, soft natural light, fine film grain. Photorealistic cinematic still frame, shallow depth of field, full-frame camera. NOT CGI, NOT 3D render, NOT illustration. NO readable text, NO logos, NO subtitles, NO watermark anywhere in frame.
prompt.tail_short: photorealistic cinematic still, muted filmic tone, no text

takes: Take 1 — 35 mm lens, the described angle exactly, balanced natural exposure.
Take 2 — 50 mm lens, a touch closer, slightly warmer white balance.
Take 3 — 85 mm lens, tighter crop on the subject, creamier bokeh.
Take 4 — slightly lower camera height, more foreground presence.
Take 5 — slightly higher camera height, cleaner background separation.
Take 6 — subject pushed to the left third, negative space on the right.
Take 7 — subject pushed to the right third, negative space on the left.
Take 8 — key light moved to hard backlight, rim on the subject, deeper shadows.
Take 9 — flatter soft light, lifted shadows, gentler contrast.
Take 10 — one stop darker overall, moodier, richer blacks.
